pass_a_gloss: Pre-martyrs ascend sooner; Ambrose priest shown Gospel blessedness; swim-the-contest condition. XIV opening recovered from slice seam.
pass_b_english: And furthermore, if one of the pre-martyrs — having more than many martyrs the love of learning in Christ — shall ascend the sooner: to thee, priest Ambrose, looking intently, the Gospel voice shows how either none ever, or very few, shall attain so choice and fuller a blessedness — in which thou too shalt be, if thou swim the contest undoubting (Matthew 19:28).

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Exhortatio exists; nothing to compare.
